item.title: Tests reveal why titanium additions do not fully prevent pitting corrosion in stainless steel
item.description: Stainless steel is widely used for its corrosion resistance, but it is not invincible. In environments containing chloride ions, such as seawater, pitting corrosion can occur. These pits often start at tiny particles called inclusions embedded in the steel.

item.title: Scientists demonstrate AI-designed enzyme for drug synthesis
item.description: The new RFD4-Proteina unified generative model for protein design—created by the Institute for Protein Design (IPD) in collaboration with NVIDIA—uses advanced AI to generate entirely new protein sequences and structures, achieving computational design success rates five to 10 times higher than previous models and generating candidates five to 10 times faster.

item.title: Designing better adsorbents to remove PFAS from water
item.description: A review by Tohoku University researchers identifies key molecular features that could guide the development of more effective materials for removing PFAS from water. The study is published in the journal ACS Materials Au.

item.title: Potatoes could be the secret to better plant-based meat, say food scientists
item.description: Potatoes could hold the key to making better gluten-free plant-based meat, according to a new study.
